title: M-2196

data.h1: M-2196 Titanium Dioxide for Solvent-Based Furniture and Industrial Paint

data.positioning_title: Where M-2196 Fits in Coatings Evaluation
positioning_paragraphs: M-2196 is a sulfate-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment with zirconia/alumina and organic surface treatment for solvent-based furniture- and industrial-paint evaluation.

Use M-2196 as a candidate when gloss, whiteness, undertone, wetting and dispersing behavior are relevant to the intended coating system. Final selection should account for binder and solvent system, pigment loading, additives, dispersion process, substrate, film build, application, drying or cure conditions, appearance and destination documents.

applications.title: Solvent-Based Furniture Paint
applications.text: Evaluate M-2196 in the intended resin and solvent system, pigment loading, additives, dispersion process, substrate, application and drying or cure conditions. Confirm gloss, whiteness, undertone, wetting, dispersion and finished appearance.

applications.title: Solvent-Based Industrial Paint
applications.text: Test M-2196 in the selected industrial coating formulation, substrate preparation, film build, application and drying or cure conditions. Confirm gloss, whiteness, dispersion, coverage and finished-film performance for the intended end use.

items: Gloss and finished appearance at the intended pigment loading and film build

evaluation.title: Formulation and Qualification Review
items: Binder, solvent package, additives and pigment loading
Substrate, surface preparation, application method and film build
Drying or cure conditions and finished-film performance
Destination needs, document scope and sample-validation results
